source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Please do not delete any existing campaigns, and do not use any leads in MeetAlfred for tests. If possible, please use your private email or something.

routing_warnings.description: The client explicitly requires preserving the existing MeetAlfred integration because a campaign is ongoing, which is related to but narrower than the target constraint against deleting existing campaigns.
The separate clause prohibiting use of MeetAlfred leads for tests belongs to the production-lead test-isolation Requirement.
